identifier: Woo Mobile App: Point of Sale Mode
statement: POS mode turns a supported tablet or phone into a digital cash register
Your store address must be in one of the supported countries.
You must be using that country’s native currency as the store currency.

* POS access is defined entirely by `woocommerce_pos_*` capabilities granted per-user — the * same primitive WordPress uses for every other authorization decision. A user * has POS access if and only if they hold at least one of the known `woocommerce_pos_*` * capabilities (those in all_pos_capabilities(); see has_pos_access()).

identifier: Woo Mobile App: Point of Sale Mode
statement: All sales sync with your existing WooCommerce site.
